The Venn diagram shown above represents two events $X$ and $Y$ and the probabilities of each event. Calculate $P(Y|X).$
question.worked_solution:
To compute $P(Y|X),$ we need to ask, "what is the probability of $Y$ occurring given that $X$ has occurred?"

Since we are assuming that $X$ has occurred, we only consider the events inside $X.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14273146/assets/96e36af7abc98925b1c70aa832913dc19ac46ec988dea71e4c6efba6a39966ed.png)

The probability of event $X$ occurring is

$$
P(X)=0.42+0.18=0.6.
$$

Now, $P(Y|X)$ can be interpreted as the proportion of $Y$ that lies inside $X,$ relative to the size of $X.$ So, we have

$$
P(Y|X)=\frac{0.18}{0.6}=0.3.
$$
